steps.what: Listen while the clients describe their feelings and behaviors.
Ask questions that help clients identify their feelings and behaviors.

tasks.design: She listens, then asks the questions in the session. No question list is filed, no alert is raised, and no listing replaces the listening. Nothing is sent after the session.
tasks.previous_blocker: The next question depends on what the client just said, which a prepared set of questions does not know.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new can ask the next question in her place.
tasks.still_hard: A client who will not name the feeling still needs her to wait.
tasks.human_edge: She hears the pause and changes the question.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still listens and still asks the questions herself.

reach.learn: The questions are asked in the session, after she has heard the client.

evidence.claim: Asking the client which feeling and which behavior belong to this moment stays a conversation. Model knowledge: a prepared question set does not know what the client just said.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
One episode is one session with one client. She listens and asks in the room. No version of the questions is filed, so the asking is not gated.
She still listens. No listing replaces that listening. No alert is raised and nothing is sent to the client afterwards.
unknowns: Whether a supervisor sits in on the session.
research_questions: Which questions she will not let anyone else ask.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: One session with one client. She still listens and still asks the questions, so nothing is shortened.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Decide which skills and strategies fit these family members and their problems.
Encourage those individuals and family members to develop skills and strategies for confronting their problems in a constructive manner.

tasks.design: She decides which skill fits this family, then encourages them in the session. No strategy list is filed, no alert is raised, and no listing replaces the conversation. Nothing is sent after the session.
tasks.previous_blocker: The skill has to fit this family's problem, which she only sees while they are talking.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new can encourage the family in her place.
tasks.still_hard: A strategy they reject still has to be dropped while they are talking.
tasks.human_edge: She notices which family member is ready to try the skill.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still chooses the skill and still encourages the family herself.

reach.role: substance abuse and behavioral disorder counselor
reach.learn: The skills and strategies are spoken with the family members in the session.

evidence.claim: Encouraging a family to use a skill stays a conversation with those people. Model knowledge: the strategy is chosen while they talk, not from a fixed menu.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
One episode is one session with one family. The encouragement is spoken. No version is filed, so the session is not gated.
She still decides the skill in the room. No listing replaces that conversation. No alert is raised and nothing is sent.
unknowns: Whether a family member who is not the client may be in the room.
research_questions: Which strategies she will not name until she has seen the family.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: One session with one family. She still chooses the skill and still encourages them, so nothing is shortened.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the case on these family relationship problems and destructive patterns of behavior.
Develop individualized treatment plans addressing those family relationship problems.
File those treatment plans as plan v1 in the client dossier.
Implement those treatment plans with the family on the other personal issues.

tasks.design: She reads the case in the client dossier ({OTHER}), writes the treatment plan herself, and files plan v1 herself. She then implements it with the family in the session. No draft writes the plan, no listing replaces the reading, and no document is sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: The plan has to address this family's patterns, which a template does not know.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new can choose or carry out the treatment in her place.
tasks.still_hard: A pattern that changes mid-treatment still needs a new plan from her.
tasks.human_edge: She decides which destructive pattern the plan addresses.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still reads the case, still writes and files the plan, and still implements it with the family.

reach.learn: The plan is the one she filed as plan v1, and she implements it with the family.

evidence.claim: Treatment plans stay with the therapist. Model knowledge: choosing which pattern to treat is a clinical judgement, and carrying the plan out happens with the family.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.

One episode is one family and one plan. She writes the plan text in s2 and files plan v1 herself in s3. No draft composes the plan. She still opens and reads the case in the client dossier. No listing replaces that reading.
Implementing the plan is live work with the family. No document is sent, so that step is not gated. No alert is raised.
unknowns: Whether the organisation requires a supervisor signature on plan v1 before she implements it.
research_questions: Which patterns she will not put in a plan until she has seen the family more than once.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: One plan for one family. She still reads the case, still writes and files the plan, and still implements it, so nothing is shortened.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the case files, including prior activities and progress notes.
State the activities, evaluations, and recommendations this progress note will include.
Draft the progress note quoting only those activities, evaluations, and recommendations.

loop.input: The session facts she stated in s2. Each fact names the client, the session date, one activity she did, one evaluation sentence in her own words, and one recommendation in her own words.
loop.output: A progress note. Each activity, evaluation, and recommendation quotes one session fact and adds nothing she did not state.
loop.check: A sentence that does not quote a session fact is dropped. A risk statement about suicide, violence, or abuse that is not in her session facts is dropped. The loop does not judge whether the evaluation is clinically right.
loop.stop: One pass. Dropped sentences are not rewritten by the loop. If the evaluation or the recommendation is missing, that part stays blank. If every sentence is dropped, there is no draft and she writes the note in the check.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template cannot tell which activity she did in this session, or which recommendation she stated.

steps.what: Check the meaning of the progress note against her activities, evaluations, and recommendations.
Maintain the case files by filing these progress notes as note v1 in the client dossier.

tasks.design: She still opens and reads the case files in the client dossier ({OTHER}), then states the activities, evaluations, and recommendations in her own words. A loop drafts the progress note by quoting only those facts. She checks the meaning, then files note v1 herself. No listing replaces the reading, nothing is sent to the client, and no alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: A template cannot know which activity happened in this session, and a sentence that adds a risk she did not state is a false record.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded loop can quote only the session facts she stated, and drop a sentence that adds a risk or a recommendation she did not state.
tasks.still_hard: A session where she stated no evaluation still needs her to write that part.
tasks.human_edge: She decides what the evaluation means.

ambition.what: On every progress note she states the activity, the evaluation, and the recommendation in her own words before any draft is written.

tasks.altitude: She still reads the case file, still states what happened, still checks every sentence, and still files note v1. The week loses only the first composition of text she already stated.

reach.learn: The note quotes only session facts she stated, and she files note v1 after she has checked the meaning.

evidence.claim: Spoken care notes can be turned into a structured report in the client record. The clinician still supplies the words.
A municipal intake assistant drafts the report and a worker checks every output. That pilot is a Wmo and youth-care intake, not a marriage and family therapy progress note.

Somerset Council reported about 11 hours a week saved per practitioner and weekly admin time down 46 percent in a children's social care pilot. The publication names no independent evaluator. Those hours are not used for this task.
In Hengelo, consultants kept their own notes on Wmo talks, so little time was saved.
UK social workers found invented suicidal ideation in AI notes.
Health data is a special category, and a decision about a person may not rest solely on automated processing.
Dutch treatment-agreement rules keep a care dossier for 20 years.

The children's social care hours, the youth-care admin survey, and vendor time claims with no baseline are not this task. Model knowledge: they are not used as hours saved on a marriage and family therapy progress note.

assumptions: She produces the session facts in s2 before any draft. Each fact names the client, the session date, one activity she did, one evaluation sentence in her own words, and one recommendation in her own words. If the evaluation or the recommendation is missing, the loop leaves that part blank and she writes it in the check.
She still opens and reads the case files in s1. No listing replaces that reading. The loop may quote only her session facts, not earlier notes.

One hour per 100 baseline hours is retiring a session fact so a later note does not repeat a recommendation she has dropped. Her reading and rewrite on this run sit in the check and are not deducted again.

The 16-point draft share is the first composition of the progress note from facts she already stated. She files note v1 herself in the client dossier ({OTHER}). Nothing is sent to the client, no alert is raised, and the draft does not score risk or decide eligibility.
Children's social care time reports, vendor time claims with no baseline, and the youth-care admin survey are not used as hours.
unknowns: Whether her dictation of session facts counts as recording a staff conversation that needs works council consent.
Whether this employer must keep note v1 for the 20 years named in the Dutch treatment-agreement rule, or for a shorter period under national rules.
research_questions: How often she rejects the draft and writes the progress note herself.

already_counted.description: Reading the drafted progress note and rewriting any activity, evaluation, or recommendation that does not match her session facts.

incremental.description: Retiring a session fact so a later note does not repeat a recommendation she has dropped.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: One progress note after one family session. The low end is her rejecting the draft and writing the note during the check. The high end is the 16-point composition minus one hour of retiring a dropped recommendation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still asks the questions, still encourages the family, still writes and implements the treatment plan, and still checks and files every progress note. The draft does not decide the evaluation.
reach: A mental health counselor learns the questions were asked in the session.
A substance abuse and behavioral disorder counselor learns the skills were spoken with the family.
A healthcare social worker learns the treatment plan is the one she filed as plan v1.
A mental health counselor learns the progress note was filed only after she checked the meaning.
skills_to_grow: Ask the next question while the client is talking.
Name the skill in the session with the family.
Write the treatment plan before implementing it.
State the evaluation in her own words before a progress note is drafted.
role.ambitious_version: The same therapist still holds the session, still writes the treatment plan, and still files every progress note. A draft only composes a note from facts she already stated.
